evidence.observation: Pressure held at about 2.91-2.96 Torr through the whole ramp at 100 sccm Ar.
During growth, pressure rose steadily with no sign of levelling off: 2.979, 3.038, 3.097, 3.177, 3.249 Torr (about 0.06-0.08 Torr per 120 s).
Argon flow stayed at setpoint (99.6-100.7 sccm), so the flow controller doesn't explain the pressure rise.
Temperature settled at 749.8 °C after overshooting to 760 °C, so the thermal behaviour is normal.
The exhaust O2 sensor is not installed, so the atmosphere can't be checked and a seal leak can't be told apart from an exhaust blockage.
